blocks.heading: 1. Circulatory System & Blood Components
bullets: Human Heart : 4-chambered (two auricles, two ventricles) showing double circulation. Normal pace maker is the Sino-Atrial (SA) Node .

Blood Composition : Plasma (55%) and Formed elements (45%): RBCs (Erythrocytes) : Lifespan ~120 days. Lack nucleus at maturity. Contain iron-rich hemoglobin to transport oxygen. Destroyed in the spleen (graveyard of RBCs).
WBCs (Leukocytes) : Part of immune system. Granulocytes (Neutrophils, Basophils, Eosinophils) and Agranulocytes (Lymphocytes, Monocytes).
Platelets (Thrombocytes) : Responsible for blood clotting (aided by Vitamin K and Calcium ions).
Blood Groups (ABO System) : Group O-negative: Universal Donor (lacks antigens).

blocks.heading: 2. Endocrine Glands & Gaseous / Digestive Systems
bullets: Endocrine Glands (Ductless Glands) : Secretions are called hormones. Pituitary Gland : Master gland, controls growth and other glands.
Thyroid Gland : Secretes thyroxine (needs Iodine; deficiency leads to Goitre).
Pancreas (Mixed Gland) : Islets of Langerhans secrete Insulin (Beta cells, lowers blood glucose) and Glucagon (Alpha cells, raises glucose). Deficiency of insulin causes Diabetes Mellitus.
Adrenal Gland : Secretes Adrenaline (fight-or-flight hormone, raises heart rate).
Digestive Enzymes : Saliva: Salivary Amylase (digests starch).
Stomach: Pepsin (digests proteins in acidic medium - HCl).
